guide_title.speaker: narrator
guide_title.text: Welcome to Huntrix and Smiling Critters The Minish Cap Three D with Rumi, CatNap, DogDay, and Derpy Tiger! Tap Play!

guide_welcome.speaker: sahur
guide_welcome.text: Roar hehehe! Derpy Tiger and Ezlo Sussie Magic Minish Cap here! Tap the glowing Kinstone Lucky Block right in front of us!

guide_starter_pop.speaker: narrator
guide_starter_pop.text: Awesome! Golden Kinstone Stars, a Minish Shrink Acorn, and a Free Kinstone Chest Spin!

guide_tap_block.speaker: narrator
guide_tap_block.text: Press Throw or tap any glowing Lucky Block to smash it open and shrink on the Magic Tree Stump!

guide_combo_sahur.speaker: sahur
guide_combo_sahur.text: Picori slash, Ezlo cap spin, tiny pounce! Super Four Sword Kinstone shockwave combo!

guide_boing_hint.speaker: narrator
guide_boing_hint.text: Boing! That Minish Boss has tough armor! Spin the Kinstone Chest for stronger Picori relics first!

guide_ready_tralalero.speaker: narrator
guide_ready_tralalero.text: Picori Short Sword ready! Scurry through the Hollow Tree Log Tunnel to bonk the Giant Green ChuChu!

guide_ready_bombardiro.speaker: narrator
guide_ready_bombardiro.text: Magical Gust Jar ready! Sneak through the Bakery Mousehole and Tipped Porcelain Jar to bonk Gleerok Dragon!

guide_ready_patapim.speaker: narrator
guide_ready_patapim.text: Cane of Pacci and Pegasus Boots on! Dash through the Lily-Pad Bamboo Pipe to bonk Mazaal Golem!

guide_ready_king.speaker: narrator
guide_ready_king.text: Digging Mole Mitts ready! Climb the Bookshelf Gear Crack to bonk Vaati Wind Sorcerer and save Hyrule!

vo_wpn_bat.speaker: sahur
vo_wpn_bat.text: Star One Picori Short Sword! Tiny blade power from the Minish woods for smashing Kinstone blocks!

vo_wpn_gong.speaker: cappuccina
vo_wpn_gong.text: Whoosh sparkle! Rumi, Mira, and Zoey unleash the Magical Gust Jar whirlwind!

vo_wpn_mallet.speaker: bananini
vo_wpn_mallet.text: Boing flip! Cane of Pacci magic beam flips every block and tipped porcelain jar upside down!

vo_wpn_taiko.speaker: lirili
vo_wpn_taiko.text: Dig dig hooray! CatNap, DogDay, and Hoppy Hopscotch love these Digging Mole Mitts!

vo_wpn_rainbow.speaker: sahur
vo_wpn_rainbow.text: Ultimate Kinstone Jackpot! The legendary Four Sword Golden Blade of Minish Champions!

vo_totem_tier1.speaker: bananini
vo_totem_tier1.text: Minish Tiny! Ezlo and Sussie activated the Magic Shrink Tree Stump portal!

vo_totem_tier2.speaker: cappuccina
vo_totem_tier2.text: Yay! Our Giant Red Toadstool and Tipped Porcelain Peony Jar is showering Kinstone Star Gems!

vo_totem_tier3.speaker: cappuccina
vo_totem_tier3.text: Whoa! It grew into a Golden Kinstone and Ezlo Shrine! Maximum Star Gem fountain!

helper_cappuccina_wake.speaker: bananini
helper_cappuccina_wake.text: Chirp caw! Ezlo and Sussie Magic Minish Cap here! Hop on the Magic Shrink Tree Stump to turn tiny!

helper_bananini_wake.speaker: cappuccina
helper_bananini_wake.text: Rumi, Mira, and Zoey reporting! The Tipped Porcelain Shrink Jar is glowing with Picori magic!

helper_lirili_wake.speaker: sahur
helper_lirili_wake.text: Derpy Tiger purr! CatNap and DogDay helped me grow the Giant Red Toadstool Sanctuary!

helper_assassino_wake.speaker: lirili
helper_assassino_wake.text: Hoppy Hopscotch and DogDay here! Our Golden Kinstone and Ezlo Shrine is showering stars!

fairy_pot_max.speaker: cappuccina
fairy_pot_max.text: All four Shrink Stump and Kinstone Sanctuaries are maxed out! Golden Kinstone fountain!

fairy_need_stars.speaker: narrator
fairy_need_stars.text: Smash more Lucky Blocks or fuse Kinstone Stars at your Shrink Stumps first!

wheel_open.speaker: cappuccina
wheel_open.text: Spin the Kinstone Chest for the Magical Gust Jar, Cane of Pacci, Mole Mitts, or Four Sword!

wheel_spinning.speaker: sahur
wheel_spinning.text: Round and round the Golden Kinstone halves spin! What awesome Minish relic will we win?

wheel_jackpot.speaker: cappuccina
wheel_jackpot.text: Golden Kinstone Fusion Jackpot! Bonus Star Gems and a glowing Ezlo heart!

vo_drop_jackpot.speaker: sahur
vo_drop_jackpot.text: Whoa! Golden Kinstone Star Gem Shower!

vo_drop_seed.speaker: cappuccina
vo_drop_seed.text: A Minish Shrink Acorn! Tap Shrink or Grow to upgrade a Magic Tree Stump Sanctuary!

vo_drop_wheel.speaker: cappuccina
vo_drop_wheel.text: Free Kinstone Spin Token! Let us spin the Kinstone Relic Chest!

vo_drop_mango.speaker: narrator
vo_drop_mango.text: Yum! Giant Hyrule Bakery Brioche and Croissant Treats!

vo_drop_latte.speaker: cappuccina
vo_drop_latte.text: Minish Picori Nectar Zoom! Super fast tiny paws and a bonus Ezlo heart!

vo_drop_bananini.speaker: sahur
vo_drop_bananini.text: Hehe! Mini Rumi, Mira, and Zoey popped out cheering!

vo_drop_confetti.speaker: bananini
vo_drop_confetti.text: Hooray! Kinstone Sparkle Confetti with Ezlo and Sussie the Magic Cap!

vo_drop_toot.speaker: lirili
vo_drop_toot.text: Boing hop! CatNap, DogDay, and Hoppy Hopscotch popped out to help!

vo_gear_boots.speaker: lirili
vo_gear_boots.text: Pegasus Boots! Dash through tiny mouseholes and jump across lily pads!

vo_gear_crown.speaker: cappuccina
vo_gear_crown.text: Ezlo Golden Minish Cap Crown! Five glowing Picori shield hearts!

vo_gear_cape.speaker: cappuccina
vo_gear_cape.text: Roc Feather Magnet Cape! Glide high and vacuum up every Kinstone Star around us!

vo_boss_alert.speaker: sahur
vo_boss_alert.text: Ooh! Watch out! A Giant Minish Cap Boss just hopped into the courtyard!

vo_pet_cappuccina.speaker: bananini
vo_pet_cappuccina.text: Caw chirp! Ezlo and Sussie Magic Minish Cap wiggles its beak and shares bonus Kinstone Stars!

vo_pet_bananini.speaker: sahur
vo_pet_bananini.text: Purr! Rumi and Derpy Tiger share warm Bakery Brioche and Kinstone sparkles with you!

vo_pet_lirili.speaker: lirili
vo_pet_lirili.text: Yay! CatNap, DogDay, and Hoppy Hopscotch give you a big hug and five bonus stars!

boss_tralalero_spawn.speaker: tralalero
boss_tralalero_spawn.text: Bloop boing! I am the Giant Green ChuChu! Stay out of my Minish Woods and Hollow Tree Log Tunnel!

boss_tralalero_boing.speaker: tralalero
boss_tralalero_boing.text: Jelly bounce! Spin the Kinstone Chest to power up your Picori Short Sword first!

boss_tralalero_ouch.speaker: tralalero
boss_tralalero_ouch.text: Whoa! Rumi, CatNap, and Derpy Tiger wobbled my giant green jelly belly!

boss_tralalero_defeat.speaker: tralalero
boss_tralalero_defeat.text: Bloop splat! Okay, you can scurry through the Hollow Log Tunnel and take the Earth Element Trophy!

vo_win_tralalero.speaker: narrator
vo_win_tralalero.text: Hooray! Giant Green ChuChu bonked! Earth Element Trophy one of four!

boss_bombardiro_spawn.speaker: bombardiro
boss_bombardiro_spawn.text: Roar hiss! I am Gleerok the Twin-Neck Dragon! This Bakery Mousehole and Tipped Jar Loft are mine!

boss_bombardiro_boing.speaker: bombardiro
boss_bombardiro_boing.text: Dragon scale bounce! Bring the Star Two Magical Gust Jar before challenging me!

boss_bombardiro_ouch.speaker: bombardiro
boss_bombardiro_ouch.text: Whoosh clang! That Magical Gust Jar whirlwind is dizzying both of my dragon necks!

boss_bombardiro_defeat.speaker: bombardiro
boss_bombardiro_defeat.text: Rumble purr! The Bakery Dollhouse Mousehole is clear! Take the Fire Element Trophy!

vo_win_bombardiro.speaker: narrator
vo_win_bombardiro.text: Awesome job! Gleerok Dragon bonked! Two Element Trophies won!

boss_patapim_spawn.speaker: patapim
boss_patapim_spawn.text: Clank boom! I am Mazaal the Wind Ruins Golem! Mind my giant golden pillar hands by the Bamboo Pipe!

boss_patapim_boing.speaker: patapim
boss_patapim_boing.text: Pillar bounce! Put on Pegasus Boots and grab the Star Three Cane of Pacci first!

boss_patapim_ouch.speaker: patapim
boss_patapim_ouch.text: Hey! How did you shrink tiny, dash through the Lily-Pad Bamboo Pipe, and flip my golden armor?

boss_patapim_defeat.speaker: patapim
boss_patapim_defeat.text: Whoosh chime! The Castor Wilds lily-pad stream is yours! Take the Water Element Trophy!

vo_win_patapim.speaker: narrator
vo_win_patapim.text: Haha! Mazaal Golem bonked! Three Element Trophies won!

boss_king_spawn.speaker: sahur_king
boss_king_spawn.text: Mwahaha! I am Vaati the Wind Sorcerer! The Royal Library Bookshelf Gear Crack is sealed!

boss_king_boing.speaker: sahur_king
boss_king_boing.text: Wind barrier bounce! Bring the Digging Mole Mitts or Four Sword Golden Blade to break my spell!

boss_king_ouch.speaker: sahur_king
boss_king_ouch.text: Zzzap! How did Rumi, DogDay, and Derpy Tiger climb the Bookshelf Gear Crack with the Four Sword?

boss_king_defeat.speaker: sahur_king
boss_king_defeat.text: Sparkle chime! My wind curse is lifted, Ezlo Cap is glowing gold, and all four Elements shine!

vo_win_king.speaker: narrator
vo_win_king.text: We did it! Vaati Sorcerer bonked and all four Minish Cap Element Trophies are ours!

vo_finale_parade.speaker: cappuccina
vo_finale_parade.text: Minish Cap Champions! Rumi, Mira, Zoey, CatNap, DogDay, Hoppy, Derpy Tiger, and Ezlo saved Hyrule!

vo_keep_playing.speaker: narrator
vo_keep_playing.text: Welcome back to the Minish Cap Courtyard! Let us shrink on the Tree Stump and scurry through tiny tunnels!

vo_chaos_on.speaker: sahur
vo_chaos_on.text: Two-X Minish Kinstone Party Mode on! Every Lucky Block pops double Kinstone Stars and fireworks!

vo_chaos_off.speaker: narrator
vo_chaos_off.text: Cozy Minish Adventure Mode! Sunny shrink-stump and tiny tunnel fun!

sahur_sleepy_zzz.speaker: narrator
sahur_sleepy_zzz.text: Hold on! Win the earlier Minish Element Trophy first before challenging this Boss!
